name: OpenAI
notes: Private. Calendar-year FY. 2024-2025: audited financial statements published by Where's Your Ed At and reported as verified by the Financial Times; operatingIncome = 'loss from operations'. Earlier years omitted: only run-rates or losses of unspecified type were reported. Net losses not used. Checked 2026-11-15: no new annual figures; only WSJ-reported 2026 quarterly figures (Q3 2026 revenue ~$10B, adjusted operating loss ~$10.9B) and no public S-1 on EDGAR, so FY2026 is not added.

anchors.source: OpenAI audited FY2024 financials (comparatives), published by Where's Your Ed At, verified by FT: revenue $3.7B, loss from operations $8.78B
